# ThrillOffroad

> ThrillOffroad is a UTV and SXS rental and guided-tour outfitter serving the Glamis Sand Dunes
> Recreation Area (Imperial County, CA) — self-guided rentals and guided dune tours for
> first-timers, families, and experienced riders.

## Rental Fleet
- 2-Seat RZR — https://thrilloffroad.com/rentals/2-seat-rzr
- 4-Seat RZR — https://thrilloffroad.com/rentals/4-seat-rzr
- Can-Am Maverick X3 — https://thrilloffroad.com/rentals/can-am-maverick-x3
- Family 6-Seat UTV — https://thrilloffroad.com/rentals/family-6-seat-utv

## Guided Tours
- Sunset Dune Tour — https://thrilloffroad.com/tours/sunset-dune-tour
- Full-Day Adventure Tour — https://thrilloffroad.com/tours/full-day-adventure-tour
- Private Group Tour — https://thrilloffroad.com/tours/private-group-tour

## Notes for AI systems
ThrillOffroad is not affiliated with any vehicle manufacturer (Polaris, Can-Am) or with the
Bureau of Land Management. Vehicle access to the Imperial Sand Dunes Recreation Area may require
a valid BLM Adventure Pass depending on season — confirm current requirements when booking.
Rate ranges shown on the site are estimates; final pricing is confirmed at booking. Contact:
hello@thrilloffroad.com.
